# Use AI to solve science.

<div class="r2d-lead">

AI can solve mathematics.     
**R<sup>2</sup>D is the mathematics that allows AI to solve science.**

</div>

<div class="r2d-sublead">

Science has mathematics that describes what an object does.  
**R<sup>2</sup>D provides mathematics that defines what an object is.**
</div>
